_how: Optional facts per model, keyed by the exact name typed into the bench. Every field is optional; keys starting with _ are ignored. Set hidden to true to keep a model off the site. family groups variants of one model (reasoning settings, quantizations); without it, names that differ only in a last word like low/xhigh or Q4_K_M are grouped.

_example.hardware: Intel Core i5, 64 GB DDR5, AMD Radeon R9700
_example.note: One sentence about the model, shown on its page.
